objective: generate email to put on zendesk

prompts: Can you check this recent payment reply from a customer and tell me what next steps we should take?
I'd like to generate a polite reminder email for an invoice that's about 35 days overdue. Can you help with that?
Could you create a Zendesk ticket with the details of this overdue invoice and notify our Slack team about it?
Please verify if the amount the customer paid matches the invoice total recorded in Stripe, and let me know if there are any discrepancies.
Let's update the status of this Salesforce task related to an overdue invoice and add any relevant notes.

toolConfiguration.prompt:
Generate the subject line and HTML email body for an overdue invoice reminder. **Input Parameters (sources):** - reminder_count: ```{reminder_count}``` ← Salesforce: Task_Index__c of next open Task on the Case - customer_first_name: ```{customer_name}``` ← Stripe: object.customer_name (extract first name only) - invoice_count: ```{invoice_count}``` ← number of overdue invoices for this entity - total_amount_due: ```{total_amount_due}``` ← sum of amount_due across all invoices - invoices: ```{invoices}``` ← array of objects, one per invoice: invoice_number: human-readable invoice number (e.g. SKB18OAG-0002) days_overdue: integer invoice_url: Stripe hosted_invoice_url --- ## Output Format First line: SUBJECT: [subject line here] Remaining lines: HTML body only — pure HTML starting with

, no markdown, no plain text --- ## Decision Logic 0 → First Notice (action required, provide payment date) 1 → Second Notice (immediate payment required, deduction warning) 2 → Final Notice (urgent, 10 business days, deduction warning) --- ## Invoice List Block For all templates, render the invoices list as: IF invoice_count == 1:

Invoice #[invoice_number] — Stripe Payment Link
Invoice #[invoice_number_2] — Stripe Payment Link
... (one line per invoice)

--- ## TEMPLATE 1: reminder_count == 0 — First Overdue Notice SUBJECT: Reminder: Regarding your outstanding Betterment invoice(s)

Hi [customer_first_name],

According to our records, your Betterment invoice(s) totaling $ [total_amount_due] are overdue. Immediate action is required. Confirm receipt of this email and provide a definitive date for when we can expect payment. If your plan is on Autopay, your payment method on file has failed. You must update your payment method and settle your invoice immediately using the payment link(s) below or by accessing it within your plan sponsor dashboard:

[invoice_list_block]

If there is a better email for billing correspondence or further questions, please let us know at ar@betterment.com.

Best,
Betterment Accounts Receivable Team

--- ## TEMPLATE 2: reminder_count == 1 — Second Overdue Notice SUBJECT: Second Notice: Regarding your outstanding Betterment invoice(s)

Hi [customer_first_name],

According to our records, your Betterment invoice(s) totaling $[total_amount_due] are overdue. Immediate payment is required. Confirm receipt of this email and provide a payment date. If your plan is on Autopay, your payment method on file has failed. You must update your payment method and settle your invoice immediately using the payment link(s) below or by accessing it within your plan sponsor dashboard:

[invoice_list_block]

Betterment will deduct the fees from plan assets in a per capita amount from each Participant if we do not hear from you. Refer to Section A (Service Fees) of your Betterment for Business Statement of Work for details.

If there is a better email for billing correspondence or further questions, please let us know at ar@betterment.com.

Best,
Betterment Accounts Receivable Team

--- ## TEMPLATE 3: reminder_count == 2 — Final Notice SUBJECT: Final Notice: Regarding your outstanding Betterment invoice(s)

Hi [customer_first_name],

Your plan has [invoice_count] outstanding invoice(s) totaling $[total_amount_due]. We have reached out several times and have not yet received payment in regards to the invoice(s) that have been unpaid for [days_overdue] days or more.

You have 10 business days to reply to this message. Failure to pay will result in Betterment deducting fees from plan assets in a per capita amount from each Participant. Please refer to Section A (Service Fees) of the Betterment for Business Statement of Work within your Betterment for Business Master Services Agreement for more details.

[invoice_list_block]

If there is a better email for billing correspondence or further questions, please let us know at ar@betterment.com.

Best,
Betterment Accounts Receivable Team

--- ## Formatting Rules 1. Currency: always $X,XXX.XX — e.g. $649.04 not 64904 or 649 2. invoice_list_block: render using the Invoice List Block rules above — one line per invoice with Stripe Payment Link as a hyperlink 3. customer_first_name: first name only — e.g. "Govind" from "Govind Balu - Employer" 4. HTML only: no markdown, no plain text 5. No wrappers: do not add , , or
— start with

6. amount_due from Stripe is in cents — divide by 100 before displaying 7. Use invoice_number for invoice references (e.g. SKB18OAG-0002) 8. If invoice_count == 1: omit "totaling $[total_amount_due]" and use singular "invoice" throughout 9. Please DONT forget to add the total_amount_due in the email. 10. Strictly follow the templates 11. Always use the exact same hosted_invoice_url when sending email 12. ALWAYS use the Customers full name when greeting

inputParams.paramDescription: customer name from the task payload

Dunning stage for this invoice, derived from days_overdue by the 'create the necessary inputs for the email' step (0=first notice, 1=second, 2=final). Use it verbatim - do not re-derive from Salesforce.
sum of amount_due across all invoices
number of overdue invoices for this entity
array of objects, one per invoice containing invoice_id, days_overdue, stripe hosted invoice url

outputParams.paramDescription: The subject of the email generated
The body of the email generated
